Bid, Be °cittasu°); sukhayati ~aṃ, Abhidh-s-mhṭ 64, 20 ; ~āni passa­ddhāni, Vism 636, 2 ; Abhidh-av 1285; ~ānaṃ oḷāri­katte, Vism 274, 25 = Sp 412, 4 = Paṭis-a 492, 22 ; Vism 465, 22 foll. = As 130, 12 foll. = Abhidh-av 20, 2 foll.; ~ānaṃ kallatāya samāhito, Th-a l 83, 15 ; Vv-a 244, 11 ; ~ānaṃ daratho, Nidd-a ll 106, 18 ; ~ānaṃ gelañña­vyūpa­samana­lakkhaṇā, Abhidh-s-mhṭ 85, 23 ; ghātā (Thī 475) ti ~ānaṃ upaghātā vadhā, Thī-a 260, 10 ; ~ehi parahitârambho viriya­pāramitā, Cp-a 280, 28 = Sv-pṭ l 91, 18 ; yaṃ cittaṅgaṃ labhati yevā (Sp 270, 28 ) ti ~aṃ vācācittan ti, Vjb 108, 22 ; — as t. t. Vin. one of the sam­uṭ­ṭhāna s, cf. s.v. kāya-kamma, q.v.: yā ( sc. āpatti) ~ato samuṭṭhāti ayaṃ paṭhamapārājika­samuṭṭhānā nāma, Kkh(2) 37, 2 , cf. s.v. āpatti 1.d(β), q.v.; idaṃ sik­khā­padaṃ tisamuṭṭhānaṃ ~ato vācā­cittato kāya­vācā­cittato, Sp 463, 24 ; ~ato (Sp 541, 22 ) ti hatthamuddāya obhā­san­tassa, Sp-ṭ ll 323, 7 ; ~ā na vācikā, Vin V 87, 38 * ; satta sikkhāpadā ete vācā na ~ato, 89, 2 * ; ~ā samuṭṭhāti, Vin-vn 1183; Pj l 33, 16 ; — ifc. akilanta‑ ° (Pv-a 3, 16 ); anapakaṭ­ṭha‑ ° (Spk ll 168, 26 ); anuggahita‑ ° (Paṭis-a 590, 4 ); apa­kaṭ­ṭha‑ ° (Spk ll 168, 29 ); abbhunnata‑ ° (Sp 206, 6 ); un­nata‑ ° (Sp 606, 23 ); kilanta‑ °; dukkhita‑ °; nirāmaya‑ °; pas­sad­dha‑ °; rakkhita‑ °; sa‑ °; santa‑ °; sammā-passaddha‑ °; — °‑upadhi-viveka, m., separa­tion from bodily and mental attachment, cf . upadhi-viveka, q.v. ; ~e … bhaji, Vism 212, 7 = Sp 125, 1 ; ~ehi vivittassa, Sv 1061, 27 = Mp lV 119, 15 ; ~e sukhaṃ, Nidd-a ll 135, 1 ( so Be; Ee °viveka­sukh°); ~ānaṃ rasaṃ, Ja lll 197, 9 ´ ; Pj ll 299, 18 ; — °‑ kila­matha, m., exhaustion of body and mind; ~o, Ps lV 31, 7 , cf.
